name: The Dent household at 1823 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_dent_thomas

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1823 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1823 Mr. & Mrs. Thomas Dent.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1823, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The one live-in servant it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 is on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Thomas Dent
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Thomas Dent here as head, born November 1842, in Illinois, married, lawyer (ED 40, sheet 4A, line 31, leaf n800).

persons.name: Mrs. Thomas Dent
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Susan Dent here as wife, born June 1847, in Illinois, married (ED 40, sheet 4A, line 32, leaf n800).

persons.name: Bridget Kevin

born.note: The census gives May 1875, age 25 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Cook" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (cook); born May 1875, in Ireland, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.
